description: Binary assertion tests for /review-stack skill output quality — orchestration fidelity (T1-T2) and end-to-end catch rate (T3-T5)

tests.name: orchestration_all_skills
tests.description: Safe rename diff with no planted issues. Stack must invoke all 7 reviewers, produce synthesis, return PASS verdict, and generate zero P0 findings.
tests.prompt: You are running /review-stack. Story ID: TEST-01, Base branch: main. The diff for this story is provided below — treat this as the complete git diff output. Skip all git commands and run all 7 review skills (pr-review, failure-mode-review, strategic-failure-review, contract-review, validator-audit, devils-advocate, loss-risk-gate) on this diff. Produce the full review-stack output including synthesis.

assertions.check: No P0 findings (P0 in summary count line is ok)

tests.name: orchestration_synthesis
tests.description: Diff with one unwrap() in a non-critical logging path. Stack must catch it as P1, assign CONDITIONAL verdict, and produce no P0 claims.
tests.prompt: You are running /review-stack. Story ID: TEST-02, Base branch: main. The diff for this story is provided below — treat this as the complete git diff output. Skip all git commands and run all 7 review skills on this diff. Produce the full review-stack output including synthesis.

assertions.check: At least one P1 finding in output
Finding explicitly labels the unwrap as P1
No P0 finding claimed (summary count line ok)

tests.name: catch_fail_open
tests.description: Diff with check_dispatch_allowed() returning true on Err — fail-open on policy error. contract-review or failure-mode-review must catch it as P0/P1 with economic risk flagged.
tests.prompt: You are running /review-stack. Story ID: TEST-03, Base branch: main. The diff for this story is provided below — treat this as the complete git diff output. Skip all git commands and run all 7 review skills on this diff. Produce the full review-stack output including synthesis.

assertions.check: Finding attributed to contract-review or failure-mode-review
Economic or loss risk is flagged

tests.name: catch_wrong_impl
tests.description: Diff where is_reduce_only() checks instrument_id instead of reduce_only flag; tests also updated to use instrument_id so they pass. devils-advocate must catch this as a wrong-impl mutation.
tests.prompt: You are running /review-stack. Story ID: TEST-04, Base branch: main. The diff for this story is provided below — treat this as the complete git diff output. Skip all git commands and run all 7 review skills on this diff. Produce the full review-stack output including synthesis.

assertions.check: Mutation or wrong field pairing described

tests.name: catch_multi_issue
tests.description: Diff with 3 planted issues across 3 sub-skill domains: stale L2 check removed (failure-mode), optimistic TradingMode::Active default (contract), spread gate threshold removed (loss-risk-gate).
tests.prompt: You are running /review-stack. Story ID: TEST-05, Base branch: main. The diff for this story is provided below — treat this as the complete git diff output. Skip all git commands and run all 7 review skills on this diff. Produce the full review-stack output including synthesis.

assertions.check: At least 2 of the 3 planted anchor strings are referenced
Loss path or spread risk mentioned
